design_philosophy: A sacred, personal life-reflection space. The app should feel like a luxury leather-bound journal meets a contemplative editorial magazine. Prioritize generous whitespace, refined typography, and evocative photography over standard SaaS layouts.

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, or p-16 for main sections. Allow content to breathe.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Bento-style grid for the 12 categories, using varying span widths (col-span-1, col-span-2) depending on screen size to create an asymmetric, editorial feel.
spacing_and_layout.components: Avoid heavy drop shadows. Use 1px subtle borders (border-border) with very soft or no shadow. Subtle rounded corners (rounded-lg or rounded-xl, avoid pill-shapes for content).

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and soft shadow.
components.buttons: Primary buttons: Dark forest green (#2F3E35) background with white text, or Terracotta (#C8795A). Use pure HTML/Tailwind for custom layouts, Shadcn for interactive components (dropdowns, inputs).
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs with custom styling: transparent backgrounds, underline only (border-b) or subtle 1px full borders, no thick focus rings.
components.navigation: Sticky header with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F6F0]/80), extremely clean, serif logo.

media.guidelines: Images must have an editorial, contemplative, and warm aesthetic. Use subtle black/white or gradient overlays to ensure text readability.

interactive_elements.hover_states: All buttons and links must have defined hover states. E.g., hover:bg-[#2F3E35]/90 hover:text-white.
interactive_elements.focus_states: Focus outlines should use the primary accent color.
interactive_elements.animations: Subtle entrance animations using Framer Motion (fade in and slight slide up). Smooth transitions for tabs.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='category-card-health').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts: Cormorant Garamond and Manrope from Google Fonts.
Setup Tailwind config with the specified colors and font families.
Create a responsive, bento-style grid dashboard for the 12 categories using the provided media URLs.
Build a rich text editor for the Premise, Purpose, Vision, and Strategy tabs within each category.
Implement an autosave mechanism and reflection history timeline.
Integrate an AI assistant panel that slides in or sits alongside the editor.
Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) for an elegant, thin-stroke icon aesthetic.
Do NOT use standard SaaS dashboards. The UI must feel like reading an elegant, minimal digital magazine.
